FLPCM.Title: Foundry LPC Mobile
FLPCM.Settings.enabledHint: Use the mobile interface for non-GM users on compact screens.
FLPCM.Settings.desktopPreviewHint: Enable the player interface at any screen width for this browser. Requires a player login.
FLPCM.Settings.maxWidthHint: Activate the mobile interface at or below this CSS pixel width.
FLPCM.Settings.nativeUIHint: Turn this off to return to the mobile player interface.
FLPCM.Settings.confirmExplorationHint: Preview and confirm movement outside combat, instead of moving immediately.
FLPCM.Settings.combatMovementHint: Default to turn-only movement. The DM can grant temporary exceptions in the workspace.
FLPCM.Settings.spriteEffectsHint: Use configured LPC sprites. Disable to restore normal token artwork.
FLPCM.Settings.lowEffectsHint: Remove blur, shadows, and decorative motion on slower devices.
FLPCM.Settings.reducedMotionHint: Use static sprite frames and reduce interface and movement animation.
FLPCM.UI.helpText: Tap the map to move, drag to pan, and pinch to zoom. When your character leaves the screen, tap their portrait at the edge to recenter. Tap a creature to inspect or target it; target several creatures for multi-target spells. Act opens your actions, spells, inventory, and interactions. Pin up to three favorites with the star button. In combat, confirm your route before moving. Tap Chat again, or outside it, to close it. Incoming requests and DM responses appear as prompts.
FLPCM.UI.noCharacter: Ask the DM to assign a character you own.
FLPCM.UI.noToken: Your character needs a token in this scene.
FLPCM.UI.failed: The operation failed. Please try again.
FLPCM.UI.favoritesFull: Three actions are pinned. Unpin one before adding another.
FLPCM.UI.endTurnConfirm: Are you finished with your turn?
FLPCM.UI.actionDenied: Use regular actions on your turn. Reactions and checks remain available; the DM can grant an exception.
FLPCM.UI.movementDenied: Movement is unavailable. Check the pause state, your turn, and token permissions.
FLPCM.UI.blocked: That route is blocked or exceeds the system's movement constraints.
FLPCM.UI.moveChanged: The scene, character, or turn changed. Choose your destination again.
FLPCM.UI.movementWarning: This exceeds your walking speed. Confirm any extra movement with the DM.
FLPCM.UI.nothingMore: You notice nothing more from here.
FLPCM.UI.intentHelp: Tell the DM what you attempt with {target}.
FLPCM.UI.intentPlaceholder: I wedge my sword beneath it and try to lever it aside…
FLPCM.UI.sent: Your request was saved and sent to the DM.
FLPCM.UI.requestUpdated: The DM updated your request. Open More → Requests.
FLPCM.UI.spriteLoadFailed: Could not load the LPC sheet for {name}. Check its frame dimensions in Scene setup.
FLPCM.UI.rollAlreadyPending: A roll is already pending for this request.
FLPCM.UI.newRequest: A player sent an interaction request. Open the LPC workspace to respond.
FLPCM.UI.selectRequest: Select a request to read, reply, or ask for a roll.
FLPCM.UI.invalidDC: Enter a DC between 0 and 100, or leave it blank.
FLPCM.UI.publicReply: Send this reply publicly to the table
FLPCM.UI.assignCharacter: Assign a character in user configuration.
FLPCM.UI.placeToken: Place the assigned character's token in this scene.
FLPCM.UI.recenterInvitation: The DM suggests recentering on your character. Recenter now?
FLPCM.UI.sceneHelp: Mark selected tiles as interactive and configure sprites for selected tokens. Interactions always go to the DM for adjudication.
FLPCM.UI.selectTile: Select a tile using Foundry's tile controls first.
FLPCM.UI.selectTokens: Select one or more tokens first.
FLPCM.UI.targetMissing: The target no longer exists in that scene.
FLPCM.UI.spriteHelp: Preview a sheet, then apply it to selected tokens or save defaults on their actors. Token overrides take precedence over actor defaults.
FLPCM.UI.invalidSprite: Choose a valid image and an FPS between 1 and 30.
FLPCM.UI.verbsHelp: Comma-separated values: inspect, open, use, take, push, listen. Custom descriptions are always available.
FLPCM.UI.bulkHint: Use the LPC workspace for previews, bulk application, and clearing token overrides.
